Cam/VVT signal out of range: check the camshaft position sensor, its connector and wiring, and the oil level; a worn timing chain can also cause it. Toyota flash code 18.

Electrical fault in the VVT oil control valve circuit: check the OCV connector and wiring, then the valve. Toyota flash code 39.
